chunks: He (peace be upon him) said on the morning of the day when he was struck

key_terms.سُحْرَة: The early morning hours before dawn prayer
key_terms.ضُرِبَ: Was struck (referring to the sword blow)

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say on the morning he was fatally struck?
ai.summary: This phrase marks the temporal anchor for Imam Ali’s (AS) final sermons and supplications on the morning of his martyrdom, following the strike by Ibn Muljam. In Shia tradition, this moment is viewed not merely as the end of his life but as the culmination of his political and spiritual leadership, emphasizing his patience (sabr) and readiness for divine judgment. The context highlights the transition from earthly governance to eternal reward, a theme central to the theology of the Ahl al-Bayt.
